keySentence: Anne was not expected — but different is not always wrong.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Matthew wanted to keep Anne. Marilla agreed to give her a chance. Green Gables became Anne's home! Anne was not expected — but different is not always wrong.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Marilla planned to send Anne back to the orphanage the next day. But quiet Matthew spoke up and said they should keep her. Something about Anne's honesty touched Marilla's heart too. Anne had never had a real home, and she wanted one so badly. Anne was not expected — but different is not always wrong. Green Gables finally became the home Anne had always dreamed of.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Marilla had firmly decided to return Anne to the orphanage the very next morning. However, Matthew, who rarely expressed strong opinions, quietly insisted that they give Anne a home. His gentle words surprised Marilla, but she realized she felt the same way deep down. Anne's raw honesty about her lonely life as an orphan had touched Marilla more than she wanted to admit. Anne was not expected — but different is not always wrong. For the first time in her life, Anne had a place where she truly belonged. Because both Marilla and Matthew chose to open their hearts, everyone's life was about to change for the better. Anne fell asleep that night knowing that Green Gables was finally, truly her home.
